name: delivery-system
description: Premium mobile-first delivery platform with Customer, Kitchen and Admin accounts.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run test
